checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is blob gas limit validated before fee sufficiency check in blob_transaction_validation?
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the blob_transaction_validation function (SG-005). 2. Trace the validation sequence to confirm total_blob_gas limit check occurs BEFORE max_fee_per_blob_gas >= blob_base_fee check. 3. Submit a transaction with total_blob_gas exceeding the limit but valid max_fee_per_blob_gas to verify proper rejection order. 4. Submit a transaction with valid total_blob_gas but insufficient max_fee_per_blob_gas to verify fee check occurs after gas limit check. 5. Verify error messages indicate correct rejection reason based on validation order.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0065, Trust Boundary: tb-008, Source Invariant: SG-005/INV-002. CONDITIONAL SCOPE: This property requires further investigation to confirm bug bounty eligibility. The validation order is important to prevent fee-based attacks when gas limits are exceeded.

checklist.title: Verify Pre-condition: Can blob transaction validation be bypassed with out-of-limit blob gas?
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all code paths that invoke blob_transaction_validation. 2. For each path, verify that total_blob_gas is computed correctly from the transaction's blob count. 3. Attempt to submit transactions with maximum blob count to test boundary conditions. 4. Verify that the gas limit check cannot be bypassed through integer overflow or underflow in total_blob_gas calculation. 5. Check that the comparison uses consistent types (no truncation issues).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0065, Covers: actor-tx-sender via tb-008. CONDITIONAL SCOPE: Requires investigation. This is a falsification check designed to attempt bypassing the pre-condition that blob gas limit must be checked first.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does blob_transaction_validation (tb-008) properly short-circuit on first invalid versioned hash?
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all entry points where blob transactions are submitted (Transaction interface). 2. Locate the blob_transaction_validation function (SG-005) that validates versioned hashes. 3. Review the iteration logic: verify that validation stops immediately upon finding the first invalid hash. 4. Attempt to submit a blob transaction with multiple invalid versioned hashes and verify InvalidBlobVersionedHashError is raised on the FIRST invalid hash (not after processing all). 5. Measure gas/resource consumption to ensure no unnecessary processing occurs after the first failure. 6. Check for any code paths that might continue processing after an invalid hash is detected (e.g., try-catch blocks that swallow errors, loops that don't break properly).
checklist.falsification_approach: Attempt to submit a blob transaction where: (a) the first versioned hash is valid, (b) subsequent hashes are progressively invalid. Verify that validation stops at the first invalid hash and does not process remaining hashes. If all hashes are processed regardless, the short-circuit invariant is violated.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0066, Trust Boundary: tb-008, Invariant: SG-005/INV-004. CONDITIONAL SCOPE: Bug bounty eligibility is conditional - requires further investigation to determine if this specific short-circuit behavior constitutes a security vulnerability or is merely a correctness/efficiency concern. The property is INFORMATIONAL severity and marked as not bug-bounty-eligible, suggesting this may be more of a code quality issue than a security vulnerability.

checklist.title: Verify actor-tx-sender cannot exploit blob validation processing to cause resource exhaustion
checklist.test_procedure: 1. As an external transaction sender (actor-tx-sender), craft blob transactions with varying numbers of invalid versioned hashes. 2. Measure the computational resources (gas, CPU time, memory) consumed when processing these transactions. 3. Verify that resource consumption is bounded by the position of the first invalid hash, not by the total number of hashes. 4. Attempt to submit transactions with maximum allowed blob count where early hashes are valid but later ones are invalid - verify early termination prevents unnecessary work. 5. Check if lack of short-circuit behavior could allow an attacker to amplify resource consumption.
checklist.falsification_approach: Submit blob transactions with N versioned hashes where hash at position 1 is invalid. Compare resource usage against transactions where hash at position N is invalid. If resource usage scales with N regardless of invalid hash position, short-circuit is not working.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0066, Supporting check for node: actor-tx-sender. This check verifies the security implications of the short-circuit behavior from the attacker's perspective.
